# TravelSync AI

> Plan trips together over LINE. A group chat bot turns free-form messages into a shared, structured trip plan: itinerary, decisions, votes, expenses, packing — with a per-trip AI orchestrator that drafts options and proposes updates the group reviews in one tap.

## Product

- LINE bot for group trip planning (Mandarin + English UI)
- Web companion at /app for richer views: itinerary, decisions, expenses, ops, readiness, profile

## For LLMs and agents

- This site does not expose a public API. The conversational surface is the LINE bot itself.
- Architecture and developer docs live in the source repository, not on this site.

## Contact

For partnerships or integrations, reach out via the contact link on the marketing site.
